## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] Verified in the demo (`pnpm dev`) where the change is visible
- [ ] `knowledge/` updated when the API, data model, theming or behaviour changed
- [ ] No reference to any commercial product, its branding or its internals
- [ ] Package versions bumped together when this is a release
